retained_separate_inputs.title: Finite Chebotarev realizations
retained_separate_inputs.source_locator: Milne CFT v4.03, VIII Theorem 7.4 p.259; V.1 and V.1.9 pp.152-153; finite-field application register and compatibility checks in closure-batch-008
retained_separate_inputs.objects_and_maps: Finite normal closures of: the Hilbert class field; the moving-character radical/cyclotomic/Tate compositum; the fixed witness division torsor; finite quotients for the original basis cochains; and joint finite reductions of weight-two constituent representations. Each prescribed element is the restriction of an actual Galois element, and each non-class-function use selects a place realizing that representative.
retained_separate_inputs.hypotheses_and_discharge: The moving radical multipliers respect every Kummer relation; Tate adjustment lies in the actual radical-fixing kernel. The witness detector uses one h*tau before precision varies. Finite cochains factor through finite quotients, made normal over Q before applying density. Joint representation reductions and actual elements make trace prescriptions compatible. Each extension is finite Galois and the conjugacy class nonempty; exclusions are finite.
retained_separate_inputs.conventions: Arithmetic Frobenius x -> x^N(p). A rational prime supplies a conjugacy class; the chosen place fixes its representative and transported coordinates. Cochain equality is established at increasing finite precision before multiplying by localized minimal-model inclusions. No infinite-level density assertion or independent constituent prescriptions.
retained_separate_inputs.translation_justification: The explicit composita, maps and nonempty classes for every registered use are given in batch 8. Existing Hilbert-class, open-image, Kummer, kernel-detection and coefficient/local-representation inputs are retained as dependencies. In particular this does not close A032, A064, A068, A070 or A080.

retained_separate_inputs.title: Good reduction and finite endomorphism descent
retained_separate_inputs.source_locator: Part I Theorem 12.1(a), p. 55; Theorem 10.15, p. 49; Proposition 10.20, p. 50; Lemma 14.5, p. 63; Part IV Theorem 3.5, pp. 141-142 and Lemma 3.9, p. 143.
retained_separate_inputs.objects_and_maps: W0=Res_K/Q A, geometric End lattice rank≤16F0²; Galois kernel E; L=EK.
retained_separate_inputs.hypotheses_and_discharge: Consumes the earlier finite-etale cover and good reduction construction and the restriction-of-scalars abelian variety W0.
retained_separate_inputs.conventions: Unramified versus good reduction: prime-to-residue coefficient prime; action on ordered conjugacy Hom comes via End(W0), not arbitrary labels.
retained_separate_inputs.translation_justification: Milne I.10.15 bounds integral endomorphism rank; a finite basis descends over a finite extension. A finite-order integral action congruent to identity mod 3 has eigenvalues 1 by I.14.5 and is semisimple in characteristic zero, so reduction modulo 3 is faithful. NOS and unramified induction show inertia acts trivially on Tate and hence End away from T. Passing to EK fixes the factor labels and all ordered Hom groups.

Ribet's right-Hom lattice convention gives the same endomorphism order, and the division uniformizer acts by Frobenius. retained_separate_inputs.source_locator: Carayol sections 0.3-0.7, Theorem A pp.409-411; Casselman Theorem 1 pp.302-306, corollary p.306, Theorem 4 p.313
retained_separate_inputs.objects_and_maps: Weight-two constituents obtained by multiplying weight3/2 form by theta; odd p with new level exponent1 and primitive ramified quadratic character.
retained_separate_inputs.hypotheses_and_discharge: F=Q has odd degree, so no extra finite discrete-series place. All cusp eigenconstituents, old multiplicities and Eisenstein terms handled. Coefficient place lies over2; local residue p is odd.
retained_separate_inputs.conventions: Carayol uses geometric Frobenius and contragredient local parameter. Dualize representation AND change Frobenius to obtain X²-T_q X+q<q>. Bad Fourier U_p equals unramified-line eigenvalue only via local newvector normalization.
retained_separate_inputs.translation_justification: Conductor1 and ramified determinant rule out special/supercuspidal cases; obtain one unramified and one ramified line. Integral trace identity follows from diagonal matrices without dividing by2 or using integral eigenspace projectors.

retained_separate_inputs.objects_and_maps: Weight-two constituents obtained by multiplying weight3/2 form by theta; odd p with new level exponent1 and primitive ramified quadratic character.

retained_separate_inputs.translation_justification: Conductor1 and ramified determinant rule out special/supercuspidal cases; obtain one unramified and one ramified line. Integral trace identity follows from diagonal matrices without dividing by2 or using integral eigenspace projectors.

historical_citation_inventory.title: de Rham property and weights
historical_citation_inventory.source_locator: Scholze published 2013, Corollary 1.8 pp.5-6, Theorems 9.1 p.74 and 9.3 p.75, with published 2016 corrigendum; Brinon-Conrad 2009 Theorem 5.2.1 and Propositions 6.3.3,6.3.8; Milne AV v2.00, I Theorem 12.1(a)
historical_citation_inventory.objects_and_maps: Actual Tate representation of A over L′; descend de Rhamness to Q_l and pass to multiplicity summand r_l.
historical_citation_inventory.hypotheses_and_discharge: Smooth proper A, finite local extension; de Rham category closed under summands and finite-extension descent. Hodge multiplicities must be compatible with the B action.
historical_citation_inventory.conventions: Tate module is dual to etale H1 cohomology; cyclotomic weight -1. Each r_l has weights {0,-1}.
historical_citation_inventory.translation_justification: Comparison supplies de Rhamness of the geometric representation; descent and Morita multiplicities are separate standard inputs. Hodge–Tate alone would not imply de Rham.
historical_citation_inventory.review_scope: Source statement, hypotheses, conventions and recorded translation checked for the registered consumers, with named internal premises and integrated repairs. This does not certify all upstream lemmas or the main theorem.
